verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an open-source framework and CLI like Pipecat, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or usage tracking, or any opt-out switch for it. The built-in metrics doc covers developer-enabled pipeline performance metrics, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
